templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA under which both parties may share and must protect each other's confidential information.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover Page for the Mutual NDA capturing deal-specific terms (parties, purpose, effective date, term, governing law) that incorporates the NDA Standard Terms.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for selling and buying cloud software / SaaS, covering access, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support response-time commitments, with service credits, designed to attach to the Cloud Service Agreement.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Terms governing a provider's processing of customer personal data, including subprocessors, security, data transfers and GDPR/CCPA obligations.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-stage design partnerships where a customer gets early product access in exchange for feedback.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services and deliverables under statements of work.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Terms for business partnerships such as referral, reseller or co-marketing relationships, including obligations, fees and trademark use.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement governing a business associate's use and disclosure of protected health information.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard Terms for licensing installed / on-premise software, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product before a customer commits to a full commercial agreement.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum covering the use of AI services, including treatment of inputs and outputs and restrictions on training with customer data.
